import math

# Data points
belgian_franc = [10164, 2245, 16408, 13327]
canadian_dollar = [10371, 10724, 11176, 10806]

n = len(belgian_franc)

# Calculate means
x_mean = sum(belgian_franc) / n
y_mean = sum(canadian_dollar) / n

print(f"Belgian Franc mean: {x_mean}")
print(f"Canadian Dollar mean: {y_mean}")

# Calculate Pearson correlation
numerator = sum((belgian_franc[i] - x_mean) * (canadian_dollar[i] - y_mean) for i in range(n))
sum_x_squared = sum((x - x_mean) ** 2 for x in belgian_franc)
sum_y_squared = sum((y - y_mean) ** 2 for y in canadian_dollar)

print(f"Numerator: {numerator}")
print(f"Sum x squared: {sum_x_squared}")
print(f"Sum y squared: {sum_y_squared}")

denominator = math.sqrt(sum_x_squared * sum_y_squared)
print(f"Denominator: {denominator}")

r = numerator / denominator
print(f"Pearson correlation: {r}")
print(f"Rounded to 4 decimal places: {round(r, 4)}")
EOF
